segments.an7.70:1.1: Atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.an7.70:1.2: “kiṃ nu kho, bhikkhu, sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya, kusalaṃ bhāveyyā”ti?
segments.an7.70:1.4: “satthāraṃ kho, bhikkhu, sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya, kusalaṃ bhāveyya.
segments.an7.70:1.10: paṭisanthāraṃ kho, bhikkhu sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya, kusalaṃ bhāveyyā”ti.
segments.an7.70:2.2: “ime kho me dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā, yaṃnūnāhaṃ ime dhamme gantvā [gahetvā (ka.)] bhagavato āroceyyaṃ.
segments.an7.70:2.3: Evaṃ me ime dhammā parisuddhā ceva bhavissanti parisuddhasaṅkhātatarā ca.
segments.an7.70:2.4: Seyyathāpi nāma puriso suvaṇṇanikkhaṃ adhigaccheyya parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ.
segments.an7.70:2.6: ‘ayaṃ kho me suvaṇṇanikkho parisuddho pariyodāto, yaṃnūnāhaṃ imaṃ suvaṇṇanikkhaṃ gantvā [gahetvā (ka.)] kammārānaṃ dasseyyaṃ.
segments.an7.70:2.7: Evaṃ me ayaṃ suvaṇṇanikkho sakammāragato parisuddho ceva bhavissati parisuddhasaṅkhātataro ca.
segments.an7.70:2.8: Evamevaṃ [kho (ka.)] me ime dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā, yaṃnūnāhaṃ ime dhamme gantvā [gahetvā (ka.)] bhagavato āroceyyaṃ.
segments.an7.70:2.9: Evaṃ me ime dhammā parisuddhā ceva bhavissanti parisuddhasaṅkhātatarā cā’”ti.
segments.an7.70:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an7.70:4.1: “Idha mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.an7.70:4.2: ‘kiṃ nu kho, bhikkhu, sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya, kusalaṃ bhāveyyā’ti?
segments.an7.70:4.3: Atha kho tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi –
segments.an7.70:4.4: ‘satthāraṃ kho, bhikkhu, sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya, kusalaṃ bhāveyya.
segments.an7.70:4.8: Atha kho tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi –
segments.an7.70:4.9: ‘ime kho me dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā, yaṃnūnāhaṃ ime dhamme gantvā bhagavato āroceyyaṃ.
segments.an7.70:4.10: Evaṃ me ime dhammā parisuddhā ceva bhavissanti parisuddhasaṅkhātatarā ca.
segments.an7.70:4.11: Seyyathāpi nāma puriso suvaṇṇanikkhaṃ adhigaccheyya parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ.
segments.an7.70:4.13: ayaṃ kho me suvaṇṇanikkho parisuddho pariyodāto, yaṃnūnāhaṃ imaṃ suvaṇṇanikkhaṃ gantvā kammārānaṃ dasseyyaṃ.
segments.an7.70:4.14: Evaṃ me ayaṃ suvaṇṇanikkho sakammāragato parisuddho ceva bhavissati parisuddhasaṅkhātataro ca.
segments.an7.70:4.15: Evamevaṃ me ime dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā, yaṃnūnāhaṃ ime dhamme gantvā bhagavato āroceyyaṃ.
segments.an7.70:4.16: Evaṃ me ime dhammā parisuddhā ceva bhavissanti parisuddhasaṅkhātatarā cā’”ti.
segments.an7.70:5.2: Satthāraṃ kho, sāriputta, bhikkhu sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya, kusalaṃ bhāveyya.
segments.an7.70:5.3: Dhammaṃ kho, sāriputta, bhikkhu sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya, kusalaṃ bhāveyya.
segments.an7.70:5.8: paṭisanthāraṃ kho, sāriputta, bhikkhu sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharanto akusalaṃ pajaheyya, kusalaṃ bhāveyyā”ti.
segments.an7.70:6.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an7.70:6.2: “imassa kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
segments.an7.70:6.3: So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme sagāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:6.4: Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhammepi so agāravo”.
segments.an7.70:7.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe sagāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:7.2: Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghepi so agāravo.
segments.an7.70:8.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe agāravo sikkhāya sagāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:8.2: Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe agāravo sikkhāyapi so agāravo.
segments.an7.70:9.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe agāravo sikkhāya agāravo samādhismiṃ sagāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:9.2: Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe agāravo sikkhāya agāravo samādhismimpi so agāravo.
segments.an7.70:10.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe agāravo sikkhāya agāravo samādhismiṃ agāravo appamāde sagāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:10.2: Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe agāravo sikkhāya agāravo samādhismiṃ agāravo appamādepi so agāravo.
segments.an7.70:11.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe agāravo sikkhāya agāravo samādhismiṃ agāravo appamāde agāravo paṭisanthāre sagāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:11.2: Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari agāravo…pe… appamāde agāravo paṭisanthārepi so agāravo.
segments.an7.70:12.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhamme agāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhammepi so sagāravo…pe….
segments.an7.70:13.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo…pe. … appamāde sagāravo paṭisanthāre agāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:13.2: Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo…pe… appamāde sagāravo paṭisanthārepi so sagāravo.
segments.an7.70:14.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhammepi sagāravo bhavissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati. Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhammepi so sagāravo…pe….
segments.an7.70:15.1: “So vata, bhante, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo…pe… appamāde sagāravo paṭisanthārepi sagāravo bhavissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:15.2: Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhamme sagāravo saṅghe sagāravo sikkhāya sagāravo samādhismiṃ sagāravo appamāde sagāravo paṭisanthārepi so sagāravo”ti.
segments.an7.70:16.1: “Imassa kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī”ti.

segments.an7.70:17.4: yo so, sāriputta, bhikkhu satthari agāravo dhamme agāravo saṅghe agāravo sikkhāya agāravo samādhismiṃ agāravo appamādepi so agāravo.

segments.an7.70:19.1: “So vata, sāriputta, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhamme agāravo bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati…pe… yo so, sāriputta, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhammepi so sagāravo …pe….

segments.an7.70:20.2: Yo so, sāriputta, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo…pe… appamāde sagāravo paṭisanthārepi so sagāravo.
segments.an7.70:21.1: “So vata, sāriputta, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhammepi sagāravo bhavissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati. Yo so, sāriputta, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo dhammepi so sagāravo…pe….
segments.an7.70:22.1: “So vata, sāriputta, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo…pe… appamāde sagāravo paṭisanthārepi so sagāravo bhavissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
segments.an7.70:22.2: Yo so, sāriputta, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo…pe… appamāde sagāravo paṭisanthārepi so sagāravo”ti.
segments.an7.70:23.1: “Imassa kho, sāriputta, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe parisuddhā ca bhavissantīti bhiyyosomattāya parisuddhā bhavissanti nimmalā.
Sakammāragatoti ettha sa-kāro nipātamattaṃ, kammāragato kammāruddhanagatoti attho. 7.
Ettha paṭhamaṃ paṇḍupalāsataṃ, dutiyaṃ pannapalāsatañca vatvā tatiyaṃ jālakajātatā, catutthaṃ khārakajātatā ca pāḷiyaṃ vuttā.

Dīghanikāyaṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana mahāgovindasuttavaṇṇanāyaṃ (dī. ni. aṭṭha. 2.294) imameva pāḷiṃ āharitvā dassentena paṭhamaṃ paṇḍupalāsataṃ, dutiyaṃ pannapalāsatañca vatvā tatiyaṃ khārakajātatā, catutthaṃ jālakajātatā ca dassitā.
“pāricchattake pupphamāne ekaṃ vassaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ gacchanti, te tassa paṇḍupalāsabhāvato paṭṭhāya attamanā honti.

Yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pāricchattako koviḷāro, paṇḍupalāso hoti, attamanā, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā tasmiṃ samaye honti ‘paṇḍupalāso dāni pāricchattako, koviḷāro, na cirasseva pannapalāso bhavissatī’ti.

Yasmiṃ samaye devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pāricchattako, koviḷāro, pannapalāso hoti, jālakajāto hoti, khārakajāto hoti, kuṭumalakajāto hoti, korakajāto hoti, attamanā, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā tasmiṃ samaye honti ‘korakajāto dāni pāricchattako koviḷāro, na cirasseva sabbapāliphullo bhavissatī’ti.
Līnatthappakāsiniyampi (dī. ni. ṭī. 2.294) ettha evamattho dassito – pannapalāsoti patitapatto.
Ye hi nīlapattakā ativiya khuddakā makuḷā, te “khārakā”ti vuccanti.
Jālakajātoti tehiyeva khuddakamakuḷehi jātajālako sabbaso jālo viya jāto.
Keci pana “jālakajātoti ekajālo viya jāto”ti atthaṃ vadanti.
Pāricchattako kira khārakaggahaṇakāle sabbatthakameva pallaviko hoti, te cassa pallavā pabhassarapavāḷavaṇṇasamujjalā honti.
Ayañca anukkamo dīghabhāṇakānaṃ vaḷañjanānukkamena dassito, na ettha ācariyassa virodho āsaṅkitabbo.
Anupharaṇānubhāvoti khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno kittisaddassa yāva brahmalokā anupharaṇasaṅkhāto ānubhāvo.
Idha pana ubhayato paricchedo heṭṭhā sīlato upari arahattato ca paricchedassa dassitattā.
Tenetaṃ vuttanti tena kāraṇena etaṃ “catupārisuddhisīlaṃ pabbajjānissitaṃ hotī”tiādivacanaṃ vuttaṃ.
